intent: Calculate arrival before the explicitly afternoon match; check the official message without assuming a rain decision; distinguish last-touch facts, fair-play motive, intended report and unknown later ruling.
picturePurpose: The code-rendered clock entry, live contextual sentences and four independent fair-play decisions carry precise evidence. A still sports image cannot establish the last touch, unseen referee event, future ruling or official weather notice; avoid inventing these with decorative art.
